spinquant_w4a4.source: Existing Cosmos SpinQuant W4A4 packed-bank checkpoint referenced by legacy protocol.json reuse.spinquant_artifact
spinquant_w4a4.representation: two's-complement signed W4, low nibble first, G128 BF16 scales, learned shared R128 and BF16 KV
spinquant_w4a4.method_scope: Cosmos-adapted learned-rotation artifact; upstream SpinQuant source is attribution only, not the artifact producer or a claim of the official full SpinQuant runtime

quarot_w4a4.source: Existing results/quarot bank from legacy cosmos-policy-vqwam-20261024
quarot_w4a4.representation: offset-8 packed W4, G128 FP16 scales, per-Linear signed local H128 transform
quarot_w4a4.method_scope: Cosmos-adapted QuaRot artifact; upstream QuaRot source is attribution and GEMM-primitive source, not a claim that the artifact or runtime is the official full QuaRot engine

gemm_source.kernel: CUTLASS cutlass::int4b_t x cutlass::int4b_t TensorOp GEMM, int32 accumulator, SM80
gemm_source.module_binding: Minimal task-local PyTorch binding around the official QuaRot GEMM; task-local build patches only the launcher signature to accept/pass PyTorch's current CUDA stream and adds a GEMM-only pybind bridge; no official full-engine claim
adapter_changes: Explicit current CUDA stream passed from the PyTorch binding to the CUTLASS launcher
GEMM-only pybind bridge; no QuaRot KV or attention kernels
GPU execution parity not yet tested

adapter.operation: One official int4 GEMM per contiguous 128-feature group; FP32 accumulation applies the existing per-token activation scale and each group's original per-output weight scale
adapter.spinquant_codes: Used directly as signed two's-complement nibbles
adapter.quarot_codes: Offset-8 nibble encoding is rebased once with packed_byte XOR 0x88; scale tensors remain FP16 and unchanged
adapter.activations: Dynamic symmetric signed per-token A4, qmax 7, transiently nibble-packed
adapter.protected_scope: Only the frozen 280 target Linear weights are packed; target biases, non-target DiT parameters, and KV remain BF16

build.execution_location: Approved CPU PBS allocation only; never login node or local machine
build.command_template: Within the approved CPU PBS allocation, use the staged CUDA 12.8 toolkit and run python build_native.py --root <new-root>; TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=8.0 and MAX_JOBS=6 are set by the build worker
build.runtime_import_check: Add <new-root>/native_extensions/quarot_official_gemm to sys.path, then import quarot_official_gemm and assert callable(matmul); the shared object is not pip-installed

claims.cosmos_g128_scale_adapter: local source in this experiment directory
